title: Farmacias 911
description: farmacias911.com.ec Gettareq S.A., known as Farmacias 911, is a major Ecuadorian pharmaceutical company founded in 2013 in Guayaquil, combining retail pharmacy, wholesale distribution, OEM manufacturing and medical consulting across the whole country. The group operates six brands including Farmacias 911 retail, ACOSAR wholesale distribution, Galenic for private label manufacturing, One Laboratory for quality testing and Conseplus for consulting. It has grown from 11 to 500 employees with a 166 percent increase in headcount, working with global pharmaceutical giants like Abbott, Bayer, Bristol Myers Squibb, Takeda and Roche. Led by founder and CEO Marlon Morillo, the company hosted Ecuador's largest pharmaceutical convention in 2025 alongside APESFA. Its vertical integration from import and production to retail and lab testing is unique in the Ecuadorian market.
